en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umer, from Zayd Al Shahham, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The menstruating woman can recite the Quran, and the one with the post-childbirth bleeding (Nafsa’a), and the one with sexual impurity’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Zayd al-Shahham who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Women experiencing Hayd (menses), childbirth and one involved in sexual activities (because of which Ghusl (bath) is obligatory) can read al-Quran.’”
